source: Final shared working tree with portable-query inactive-cache fix; frozen local HTTP auth/web restart. No product changes made by this final browser qualification.
nativeOracle: Actual isolated local Convex and actual Better Auth cookies/brokerJWT verification through regular production app routes; no demo/local-runtime or mocked API/auth transport.
cameraOracle: Full installed Chromium, actual Browser.setPermission(camera=denied) at test origin, strict real blocked-state text, real rendered asset detail tag, actual authorized native scan resolution and record navigation.

attemptDiagnostics.resolution: Initial camera oracle used chrome-headless-shell, which lacks getUserMedia support before permission. Full Chromium with true CDP camera denial corrected that fixture. Native route guard temporarily rendered an Authorizing H1; the camera test now waits actual asset PageHeader .page__title-text before reading a tag. Final eight unique camera cases supersede earlier invalid fixture/readiness attempts. No product change was made to force those attempts to pass.

limitations: This is Chromium web qualification at four widths; Firefox, offline/demonstration, Electron runtime/package, and PowerSync transport are separate suites.

Workflow spec qualifies login, role/read-write module controls, native persistence/reload, public form submission, permitted Member reads, and denied auxiliary subscriptions; it does not claim every possible field combination or all legal filing pathways.
Camera fallback uses synthetic native asset fixtures and genuine browser permission denial; real physical cameras are outside this headless environment.
Layout oracle checks contained horizontal overflow and modal frame/content bounds; it is not a full visual/accessibility audit.
No production external credentials, remote SSO interaction, third-party AI provider, or production filings/submissions were invoked.
